hard_guards.rule: Do not read, write or migrate the previous app or its data.
No backend, accounts, cloud, telemetry, remote AI, runtime third-party requests or CDN.
Integer millimetres; fixed axis convention; exact integer splits.
All views and lists consume buildModel(); no geometry in UI code.
User input never throws; independent overlap/envelope checks; errors block export.
Never invent hardware specifications; label guidance.
Validate designs before load/import; never persist generated geometry.
Never edit a shipped Dexie version; never delete unreadable rows.
The 3D viewer never edits the design.
Evidence-only ledger; pushed != merged != deployed != live-verified; end with Skipped this iteration.

proposed_guards.rule: No native orchestration files until a runtime is pinned.
